title: Cinnabar Island
subtitle: Fossil revival, Pokémon Mansion, Secret Key, Volcano Badge

steps.text: Pokémon Lab, back room: hand the scientist your fossil (Helix → Omanyte, Dome → Kabuto, Old Amber → Aerodactyl). Leave the building and come back to collect it at Lv.5.
Lab lounge trades: Raichu → Electrode, Venonat → Tangela (holds Stardust), Ponyta → Seel.
The Gym is locked. Enter the Pokémon Mansion (north). Statues with switches open and close doors; read the diaries about Mew and Mewtwo. Grimer, Koffing, Ponyta, Growlithe, Rattata inside.
3F: press the statue switch, drop through the hole in the floor to reach 1F's sealed south part, then take the stairs down.
B1F: the Secret Key (item ball) unlocks Cinnabar Gym. Also grab TM14 Blizzard and the other items.

Blaine: Growlithe Lv.42, Ponyta Lv.40, Rapidash Lv.42, Arcanine Lv.47 (Fire Blast, Extreme Speed). Water/Rock/Ground; Lapras, Gyarados, Blastoise, Rhydon. Answer the gym quiz right to skip trainers (wrong answers force a battle).
Gym Leader Blaine. Volcano Badge and TM38 Fire Blast.
Bill meets you outside the gym and invites you to the Sevii Islands. Accept: the boat from Cinnabar's harbor goes to One Island (chapter 13). You can decline and come back later.
